summary: Entities (src/40-entities.js) rebuilt for v3: every PORT(entities) placeholder is gone and gameplay code is untouched (same positions, radii, timings, boss pattern, solids, K.entities / K.fx API; stats() fields kept). Rendering: (1) instanced part pools: each template part (bug body, wheels, wasp body/abdomen/wings, fish parts, springs, dash panels, monitors, screens, star posts, animals, boss parts, bombs, chain, capsule) is ONE InstancedMesh named e-*; the entity Object3D hierarchies stay outside the scene as transform holders and flush() copies their world matrices into stable instance slots every tick (zero-scale when hidden; pool bounding sphere = visible instances, so the camera and each shadow cascade cull whole pools). (2) far LOD: templates are built twice (lodTpl, fewer segments, small details dropped); beyond 30 m (18 m on Moyen/Économie) the far twin is drawn and casts no shadow. (3) rings: new superellipse-profile polished gold ring, near (<26 m) / far pools, spin in the instance matrix, never cast shadows, halo sprites only away from the camera, lost rings in a 32-slot InstancedMesh. (4) unique static geometry (spring pedestals, spike beds) baked per 100 m chunk. Materials (TSL): one shared MeshPhysicalNodeMaterial with per-vertex surface kinds (clearcoated paint with orange-peel bump, brushed metal, chrome, pebbled rubber, glossy plastic, sheen for skin/cloth/animals, hull panels with seams, HDR emissive eyes/LEDs/lamps) + a generated triplanar detail texture (tools/tex/entities_tex.py -> assets/tex/entities/detail.webp, 0.52 MB lossless), per-instance tint (post lamp red/blue, boss lens, boss hit flash, monitor icon/static); gold ring material (env reflections + view-space studio bands + fresnel glow), CRT monitor screens (icon atlas, scanlines, barrel, roll bar, static), procedural scrolling dash chevrons (additive HDR), iridescent wasp wings, glass dome (SSR opt-in). Everything reflects scene.environment (private fallback sky only if absent). Budgets: Ultra Act 1 worst 156 draw calls / 1.81 M tris (was 287-301 / 1.91 M), Moyen Act 1 99 calls / 677 k (was 154 / 751 k): the SPEC3 Moyen target now passes.

docs/SPEC3.md Foundation notes, K.entities: API unchanged + K.entities._dbg() (dev probes only); entity meshes are InstancedMesh pools named e-* (userData.noEnv), far LOD beyond 30 m (18 m Moyen/Économie) without shadows, rings never cast shadows, nothing on object layer 5; materials use scene.environment.

Note for test/probe authors: entity distance culling (every 6 ticks) and LOD use the camera of the previous tick (they run inside K.entities.update); after moving the camera by hand, tick a few times before rendering a screenshot.
known_issues: Gameplay culling of entities beyond 235 m still runs every 6 ticks (unchanged from v2), so right after a camera cut a far-away entity can appear up to 0.1 s late.
Instance slots are stable while an entity stays visible; when a slot is reused by another entity the post pipeline's motion vectors are wrong for that one frame (only far, newly visible entities).
The far LOD and the shadow cut-off at 30 m (18 m on Moyen) can be noticed on a large still screen as a small shadow appearing under a robot as it comes closer.
The boss and the capsule have no far LOD (they are only drawn at the arena).
